title: 8/5/26: Overcast with a High of 86 and Evening Low of 76, Light Winds and No Rain Expected Tonight - NewsBreak
text:
By Source Staff ,
4 hours ago At 7:00 PM in Maury County, the current temperature is 82°F with a light wind from the southeast at 3.6 mph. The skies are overcast, and there has been no recorded precipitation.
Earlier today, temperatures reached a high of 86.2°F and a low of 70.2°F. Winds earlier were gusty, reaching up to 11.1 mph, with a precipitation chance of 30%, though no rain was reported. For tonight, expect a low of 75.9°F, with winds increasing slightly to a maximum of 6.7 mph. The skies are expected to clear overnight, leading to a calmer atmosphere.
Looking ahead, there is a 15% chance of precipitation tonight. Overall, conditions are expected to remain stable as we transition into the early hours of tomorrow without any significant shifts in weather patterns. There are currently no official weather warnings in effect for the area.
